newsitem.title: USA: IXC Communications signs $20.1 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: IXC Communications signs $20.1 mln contract.

text.p: IXC Communications Inc said on Friday it signed its first lease agreement to provide OC-48 SONET connections for an unnamed long distance company.
The contract has a minimum revenue commitment of $20.1 million over five years, IXC said.
The company's shares were up 1-1/2 to 32-3/4, a 52-week high, in late Friday trading on Nasdaq.

The company said the contract is an "important milestone" because the carriers will be interconnecting via an optical interface. Network construction is scheduled to be completed within the next year.
IXC supplies digital transmission and long distance services.
